default.note: Single variant. There is no :preview / :dry / :broadcast sibling for `dev`; the local anvil deploy is always a real broadcast against 127.0.0.1:8545.

steps.what: pre-flight: `cast block-number` must FAIL (nothing may already answer on http://localhost:8545)
anvil --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8545 --chain-id 31337 --block-time 2 (started directly, pid captured, trap cleanup on EXIT/INT/TERM)
readiness poll (30 x 1s) + listener-pid ownership check via ss/lsof + block-number <= 100 genesis-freshness gate
./simulate-yield.sh (cast send MockDola.mint -> MockAutoDOLA, 2300 DOLA, reads addresses from progress.31337.json)
